# Pinned Omni schema fixture

`omni-v1.13.2-schema.json` is the unmodified configuration schema from:
https://github.com/siderolabs/omni/blob/v1.13.2/internal/pkg/config/schema.json

Source project: Sidero Labs Omni, licensed under its Business Source License
(https://github.com/siderolabs/omni/blob/v1.13.2/LICENSE).

The bootstrap unit test checks every emitted field against the pinned schema's
property names, types, enums and bounds. This is deliberately not a full runtime
schema validator: Omni fills omitted defaults, and the operator must supply EULA
acceptance themselves before first startup. No acceptance is generated by Companion.
